nodes.asset_description: A laptop displaying a Kick-off Meeting interface sits on a marble-topped table next to a turntable with a blue vinyl record. To the left, a small orange lamp rests on a stack of books. Two small oranges are placed on the table near the laptop. The background is a plain light-colored wall.

A young man wearing a dark blue baseball cap and glasses sits at a wooden desk, smiling at the camera. He wears a maroon long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans. On the desk are a red desk lamp, a stack of books, and a laptop displaying a website or app with a photo and text. To the left is a potted plant, and to the right is a window with blinds. A colorful drawing or poster hangs on the wall behind him.

A person wearing a green corduroy jacket over a white shirt and blue jeans sits on a red bench, typing on a black laptop. The laptop screen is dark and reflects the surrounding environment. The person wears black shoes and is seated on a light brown wooden floor. Behind them are red cabinets with gold knobs.
